labels.label: bzdef:c2s1d1_poche_affine
labels.notes: Benzecri.IsPocheAffNC (PocheNonConstante.lean:147) extends the strict, printed Benzecri.IsPocheAff (Chapter2/Poches.lean:547) with exactly one field, nonConstant : ∃ x y, z x ≠ z y, on ℝⁿ, which is where Déf. 1 puts z (« fonction linéaire z sur ℝⁿ », l.104). That is the printed definition plus DEC-178's « z non-constant », nothing more: no dimension condition is added (the empty case n = 0 is proved, not assumed: not_isPocheAffNC_dim_zero, pocheAffNCNonVide_iff). The reading of « non-constant » makes no difference: IsPocheAff.nonConstant_tfae (:194) proves five readings equivalent on a pocket: non-constant on ℝⁿ, z ≢ 0, z.linear ≠ 0, non-constant on φ(P), and z > 0 on φ(P). The printed IsPocheAff was checked against the transcription and the scan (journal p. 246–247 = PDF p. 19–20, viewed): data, condition a (IsGLB 0, ≤ 1), condition b (every compatible chart with the germ of φ at M). The witness is not vacuous. exists_isPocheAffNC_demiEspace (:425) takes V = the open half-space {x₀ > 0} of ℝⁿ⁺¹, P = {x₀ < 1}, φ from the strict exists_isPocheAff_demiEspace (CasAffin.lean:415) and z = x₀; nonConstant is witnessed by z 0 = 0 ≠ 1 = z 1, and P ≠ V. PocheAffNCNonVide (:456) carries T2, connected, second countable and HasGroupoid V (affGroupoid n), and pocheAffNCNonVide_iff (:471) proves it non-empty iff 0 < n. The restriction is real: not_isPocheAffNC_model (:255) shows the printed model (ℝⁿ, id, 0) is excluded. The mark « in corrected form, under DEC-178 » is legitimate. DEC-178 makes the corrected Déf. 1 the statement of record, and the strict library has the precedent of Lignes.lean:20–22, which marks Prop. 6 in corrected form under the same ruling. Status `closed` with the finding recorded as « Not new … Ruled by DEC-178 » is consistent with that practice.

labels.label: bzdef:c2s1d1prime_poche_projective
labels.notes: Benzecri.IsPocheProjNC (:274) extends the strict, printed Benzecri.IsPocheProj (Poches.lean:585) with exactly one field, nonConstant : ∃ x y, z x ≠ z y, with x and y in Sphere.openHemisphere l, the affine space H̊ on which Déf. 1′ defines z (l.131). That is the printed definition plus DEC-178, nothing more. IsPocheProj.nonConstant_tfae (:286) proves the same five readings equivalent on a pocket. The witness exists_isPocheProjNC_demiEspace (:443) is the Remarque transport IsPocheAffNC.toPocheProjNC (:386) of the affine witness, with the canonical projective structure projOfAff and an affine equivalence onto H₀. nonConstant transports through j (j x, j y), so the pocket is non-degenerate. PocheProjNCNonVide (:463) carries T2, connected, second countable and HasGroupoid V (projGroupoid n), and pocheProjNCNonVide_iff (:484) proves it non-empty iff 0 < n. exists_isPocheProj_not_isPocheProjNC (:356) shows that the strict counterexample (ℝⁿ, H₀, j, 0) is a printed pocket and not a corrected one, in every n. The mark is legitimate under DEC-178, as for Déf. 1.

labels.label: bzprop:c2s2p6_ligne_brisee_poche
labels.notes: IsPocheProjNC.ligne_brisee_poche (:512) takes a corrected pocket, IsLigneBrisee n (Real.log K) p A B L (strict, Lignes.lean:170), A ∈ P and z(φA) < 1/K^p, and concludes L ⊆ P ∧ ∃ hB : B ∈ P, z(φB) < K^p · z(φA). That is Prop. 6 as printed (l.437–443), with the strict <. It adds no hypothesis: any real K, no dimension condition, and V only a ChartedSpace (S n) with HasGroupoid. LigneBriseePocheNCPrinted (:558) is the strict LigneBriseePochePrinted (Lignes.lean:1032) token for token, with IsPocheProjNC in place of IsPocheProj. ligneBriseePocheNCPrinted n (:569) proves it for every n. The proof is the strict ligne_brisee_poche_of_ne_zero, fed by exists_ne_zero. The hypotheses are satisfiable. IsPocheProj.exists_hypotheses_ligne_brisee (:523) meets them on every pocket of dimension ≥ 1, for every K > 1 and p ≥ 1, and ligneBriseePocheNC_hypotheses_demiEspace (:580) instantiates this on the corrected half-space witness. That witness uses the point broken line {A} repeated p times, so B = A. This still exercises the corrected content: the conclusion z(φA) < K^p z(φA) needs z(φA) > 0, which is exactly what fails for z ≡ 0. Point segments are a reading of the strict library (isMajoreSeg_singleton), not of this file. The mark « as printed over the corrected Déf. 1′ » is legitimate under DEC-178 (« 7° and Prop. 6 then hold as printed »).

The same with `-DwarningAsError=true` exited 0, so the file is strict-ready. `pgrep -af "lake build"` showed no other build, and `taskset -c 0-11 lake build BenzecriScaffold.PocheNonConstante` reported « Build completed successfully (2563 jobs) ». grep finds no sorry, admit, axiom, native_decide, implemented_by, opaque, unsafe or set_option. docstring_contract: Present and true: the title; the three labels as **`label`** — `benzecri1960_ch2.tex:95/119/437`, at characters 865, 1331 and 1701 (under 4000), with correct start lines; the French quote of Déf. 1, Déf. 1′, Prop. 6 and its proof; `## Hypothesis checklist`; `## SCOPE (disclosed)`; the provenance line. The checklist was checked claim by claim. In particular, « K: the hypotheses force K > 1, or K < −1 with p even » holds: log K > 0 is needed for a majorised segment, and K < 0 with p odd makes 1/K^p < 0 < z. The SCOPE claim that the scan agrees with l.95–145 was checked on PDF p. 19–20. The cross-reference parentheticals (« cf. chap. 1, § 1, déf. 14 », …) are left out of the quote without an ellipsis, as in the strict Poches.lean:39–52 (house practice, not a finding).
overlap_with_Proprietes: No exact name clash. All 30 declaration names were checked against Benzecri/ and scaffold/, and the hits on the short names cote_nonneg, cote_pos_of_ne_zero, ligne_brisee_poche and septieme_propriete are in the IsPocheProj namespace, not IsPocheAff or IsPocheProjNC. The two files do not import each other. There are near-duplicates in content, listed under findings.

findings.what: Near-duplicate lemmas with the T-bz-c2-proprietes file. There is no name clash, so both can graduate as they are. (1) Proprietes' IsPocheProj.exists_ne_zero_iff_nonconstant, (∃ y, z y ≠ 0) ↔ ∃ y y', z y ≠ z y', is items 2 ↔ 1 of IsPocheProj.nonConstant_tfae here. (2) Proprietes' exists_isPocheProj_cote_ne_zero (n = 1, on demiDroiteOuverte) is subsumed by exists_isPocheProjNC_demiEspace 0 together with isPocheProjNC_iff_ne_zero. (3) The 7° conjunct of proprietes_pseudo_longueur (over IsPocheProj with ∃ y, z y ≠ 0) and IsPocheProjNC.septieme_propriete here are the same statement up to isPocheProjNC_iff_ne_zero.

summary: Each corrected definition is the printed strict structure plus the single field DEC-178 adds. Prop. 6 is stated as printed over the corrected Déf. 1′, with no added hypothesis and satisfiable hypotheses. The witnesses are non-degenerate: half-space, z = x₀, nonConstant from 0 ≠ 1. The paper-manifold non-vacuity forms are iff 0 < n, consistent with DEC-177. The marks are legitimate under DEC-178, as the precedent in Lignes.lean shows. The build passes with warnings as errors, with 0 sorry and standard axioms on all 30 declarations. The scope is clean. Two minor curation items remain for the master: near-duplicates with Proprietes.lean, and the double marking of the Déf. rows in Poches.lean.
